summary: Comprehensive testing of CARBRIDGE Catalog feature with live data synchronization from demo.pro-auctions.ru. All core catalog APIs working correctly. Frontend displays live car data with RUB prices, mileage, and year information.

minor.issue: Engine type filter returns 0 results for 'electric' because filter is applied client-side to fetched page data, not server-side on source
minor.note: This is expected behavior given the architecture - live data is fetched per page and filtered locally
